profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Whether it's cooking, photography, or thinking of my next big idea to pitch on Shark Tank, I have a creative side to me that I have always enjoyed exploring and software engineering has been an awesome medium for me to leverage that. I love learning new technologies and challenging myself to think logically, methodically, and creatively. When building an idea, a user’s experience is very important to me, so I strive to craft an interface that is innovative, visually appealing, and intuitive for everyone.

As a full stack software developer, I have enjoyed using Ruby, JavaScript, React/Redux, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, CSS, and HTML in my projects. Currently, I'm self-learning Node.js, Express, and Python. I'm always finding time to learn more!

positions.title: CEO | Co-Founder
positions.locationName: El Paso, Texas Area / San Antonio, Texas
positions.description:
Founded a fully boot-strapped company for the food and service industry and scaled the business to 6 locations. Averaging roughly one million dollars in sales per year before departure from company. 

Developed a logistical model with over 40+ employees along with general managers and regional managers all working in tandem for the company.  

Oversaw all projects geared towards expansions, event handling, catering, as well as new innovations. These projects included working with various vendors, companies, along with managers in regards to implementation. 

Formulated a digital marketing plan that grew our social media presence to the millions. Videos with over a million in views, and social media accounts that aggregate to roughly 30,0000 followers. 

Delegated Payroll,  predictive scheduling, PnL’s, and other financial reports for the company.

projects.title: Gratitude
projects.description:
Gratitude is a data visualization tool to compare a user’s monthly income with average monthly incomes from other countries

- Utilized Javascript for data retrieval and computation in order to generate a filtered dataset  rendering a visual output for the user.
 - Incorporated D3’s built-in force simulation and collision to provide an interactive experience with the plotted data points. 
- Leveraged SCSS and Javascript DOM Manipulation in order to provide a user-friendly interface

projects.title: Butterflyr
projects.description:
A single page application inspired by the popular social media site Facebook

Optimized one-to-many polymorphic tables for the friending and posts feature by using Ruby on Rails association in order to heavily DRY backend code and increasing scalability 
Harnessed the unidirectional state management of Redux to simplify React components and directly manage data for form inputs and form submissions in order to add an additional layer of security. 
Stored image uploads for user photos in the cloud using AWS S3, reducing server load and allowing for a decreased load time for fetching user’s photos. 
 Minimized database queries by eager-loading associated resources into an LRU Cache, such as user information and posts, in order to increase loading speeds and reduce server-side strain.
Combined Redux state and AJAX requests to consolidate client-side data into a normalized state and maintain a single source of truth for all React components.
Managed users and posts using CRUD fetched through AJAX requests in order to update the database using Active Record and PostgreSQL which resulted in an update to a slice of state providing a seamless user experience.
